property_summary: After a successful lockInGuess at block N, settle() must still revert at block N+1 (since settle requires block.number > block+1); the mutant locks block.number, so at N+1 settle becomes callable and pays out, breaking the invariant for the actor/hash the fuzzer finds.
change_summary: Set the locked block to `block.number` instead of `block.number + 1`, changing when settle becomes callable.
